data_sources.games: data/experiments/games_features.parquet (2227 rows, 2018-2025; v1_margin, actual_margin, market_spread, gameday)

gate.A: candidate materially beats frozen V1 validation MAE
gate.rule: ALL must pass. No single bucket may satisfy the gate. Any failure => CLOSE, vault untouched.

hypothesis: Frozen V1's effective information state is ~Tuesday morning of game week. Later-arriving non-QB player-availability information (through Friday 12:00 ET) is a fundamentally different information category ('who is playing' vs 'how the team performed') that V1's ratings cannot price. Test whether adding it improves margin prediction.

injury_feature_spec.aggregation: per game, per team: count of qualifying players per (position_group x designation). Features signed from home perspective: X = away_team_counts - home_team_counts (positive = away more injured => favors home margin). 5 groups x 3 designations = 15 features per team side, 30 total.
injury_feature_spec.cutoff_rule: keep rows with date_modified < min(kickoff, Friday 12:00 America/New_York of game week). Rows at/after cutoff are dropped. Strictly pregame by construction.
injury_feature_spec.dedup: nflverse provides one row per player-week with a single final report_status (verified 2026-09-29); no within-week transitions to resolve.
injury_feature_spec.designation_encoding: separate count feature per designation (no assumed severity ordering). Questionable is INCLUDED as its own count feature (preregistered treatment: include, not dropped, not fractional). Rows with null report_status (practice-only entries) are excluded.
injury_feature_spec.missing_data: team-game with no qualifying injury rows => all zeros. No imputation.
injury_feature_spec.mapping_note: FB (fullback) appears in 2021-2022 injury data (73 rows) but not 2018-2020; assigned to SKILL group before any validation evaluation. No validation numbers seen at mapping time.

model.architecture: candidate_margin = v1_margin + ridge_pred, where ridge_pred predicts (actual_margin - v1_margin) from the 30 signed injury-count features. V1 margin itself is frozen and untouched.
model.training_window: two-fold season cross-fit within 2021-2022 (fit on one season's V1 residuals, predict the other)
model.vault: 2023-2025 LOCKED — zero evaluations unless every gate passes

safeguards: No ATS tuning, no threshold tuning, no division/late-season/edge-bucket corrections
No weather, line movement, roster changes, coaching, or additional features
No feature shopping or config changes after seeing validation performance
Historical market lines remain the unverified single-snapshot benchmark (Exp 004); 2026 CLV kept separate
Nothing earns a V2 label from validation alone
status: PREREGISTERED — locked before any 2021-2022 validation evaluation

timing_documentation.injury_information_state: designations with date_modified < Friday 12:00 ET of game week (strictly pregame; min(kickoff, Friday noon))
timing_documentation.note: This timing difference is INTENTIONAL and is the hypothesis under test. The candidate is NOT 'V1 plus injuries' as a representation tweak — it is V1's Tuesday information set augmented with Friday availability information.
timing_documentation.v1_information_state: Tuesday morning of game week (weekly-batched ELO/EPA/GBM through previous week's games; no within-week updates)

preregistration_amendment.reason: Frozen-V1 margins (ens_margin) do not exist for 2018-2020 in games_with_preds.parquet (all 803 null) — V1 predictions begin 2021 because the weekly GBM refits require pre-2018 training history. Reconstructing 2018-2020 V1 margins would not be frozen V1 (linear components were fit in-sample on 2018-2020). No validation numbers had been seen when this amendment was made (build script crashed on NaN target before fitting).
preregistration_amendment.change: model.training_window: 2018-2020 -> two-fold season cross-fit within 2021-2022: for each season S in {2021, 2022}, fit ridge on the OTHER season's V1 residuals and predict S. Every validation prediction remains out-of-sample with respect to the injury layer; V1 stays frozen. Gate C (holds in both seasons) is evaluated on these out-of-sample predictions.
